items.text: Subscribers per 1,000 views is 0.8 on the latest finished read, against a typical 1.8. Across the show, DesignerTom converts at 3.1 per 1,000 views and Dive Club at 1.8.
items.recommendation: Add a spoken subscribe ask at a high point of each live show, about a third of the way in, and pin the same ask on Dive Club, which has more views but converts less. Compare subscribers per 1,000 views across the next episodes.

items.text: Search and suggested share is 7.7, against a typical 14.3, and still sliding. Search brings 5% and suggested videos 4.9% of YouTube views; end screens bring 0%.
items.recommendation: Rewrite the next title and first description lines around the guest's name and the tool or topic people would search for, and add end-screen links to a related episode. Then watch whether the search and suggested share moves.

items.text: E14, still in its first days, lost 4.8 of every 100 viewers about half way in, during live comment reading, and 4.8 again a little later while a guest was asked what they do. Feedback turned specific later and held 3.5 extra per 100.
items.recommendation: Test trimming or moving the comment-reading stretch and getting to the portfolio critiques sooner. Compare where viewers leave on the next episode.

items.text: E6's launch ran soft at 1189 YouTube views against a typical 1751 at that age, and two LinkedIn viewers said they couldn't hear the caller. Audio may not be the cause, but it is worth ruling out.
items.recommendation: Sound-check every call-in guest before going live, and have a host confirm in chat in the first minutes that viewers can hear them. Compare the next launch with this one.

items.text: The newest live show averaged 113 viewers against a typical 74, with 79.6 chatters per 100 viewers against a typical 53.9. Live turnout and chat are the show's strongest checks.
items.recommendation: Repeat the live portfolio-review format and invite viewers to send portfolios ahead of time, so chat keeps building. Track average viewers and chatters across the next episodes to see if it holds.
